model-binding.text: The Lean model is unchanged. The code carries the lean/ tree last changed by 53ad27ff (#344, which added the batch questions and changed no law). The transitions used here are the model's as they stand:
a fold of one request, which the model states equals a single step (fold_batch_of_one_is_step);
an owner's retract in its window;

The processing and retract windows follow requestPhase. On chain, the fold's window check is interval.is_entirely_before with an exclusive upper bound. That is why the client compares the built bound with the deadline slot as "at most".
This change decides which process and which wallet performs each transition. It does not change the transitions.

slices.text: Each slice is one change, reviewed at each step by an independent auditor, and pushed in its own pull request.

verification.text: These continuous-integration jobs run on the exact head of each pull request. Each slice adds its own evidence to them. A slice claims only what its own pull request runs.
Every slice also runs nix run --quiet .#cli-flags-check (documented flags equal --help) and nix develop --quiet -c just ci (lint, format and the documentation checks).
